subject.title: Dashboard: workspace time-travel — history scrub, version diff, and widget→logbook blame

question: Should OpenClaw accept dashboard workspace time-travel and Logbook blame as a bundled dashboard roadmap item, with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101900 as the canonical implementation candidate after the Wave 1 dashboard substrate is settled?
rationale: The request is a new user-facing auditability layer over an unsettled dashboard storage/security model, so automation cannot choose the product boundary or permanent provenance contract for maintainers.

options.title: Review Linked PR After Substrate
options.body: Keep this issue open and treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101900 as the implementation candidate once the Wave 1 dashboard backend/UI/security stack is ready for review.

options.title: Move To External Experiment
options.body: Ask for the time-travel layer to remain an external plugin or ClawHub experiment until maintainers decide whether the dashboard stack should be bundled.

options.title: Defer This Roadmap Child
options.body: Leave the broader roadmap open but explicitly defer or close this child if dashboard time-travel is not current product scope.

recommendation.title: Review Linked PR After Substrate
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101900 as the implementation candidate once the Wave 1 dashboard backend/UI/security stack is ready for review.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and merged the Logbook/plugin-tab precedent that this feature depends on, making them the best history-backed routing owner for the product-direction choice.
